name: Warm Lead Routing
description: Lead-warmth scoring from intent and engagement signals — Warmly website-visitor identification, CRM form fills and email engagement, and Calendly booking activity — using an explainable Hot/Warm/Warm-Cool/Cool tiering, plus routing recommendations based on owner continuity, CRM routing rules, or rep capacity, and the degradation path to CRM-only signals when intent tools aren't connected.
